decisions: Message maps all six actual wrappers. Visual frame names are not promoted to code identities: the native horizontal Message content example supplies the 8px avatar/row gap, while the actual MessageContent code wrapper is vertical and takes the observed 10px vertical gap. Representative group gap 24px,32px round avatar,12px metadata inset and 12/16px footer text are retained. Native header frame 16px conflicts with its actual 14/20px text; this reference retains 20px text height without clipping. Footer has 24px minimum and grows for native actions. Speaker/time and delivery text are explicit caller content, not inferred states or automatic announcements. Align=end reverses the row using actual data-align; logical layout works with direction. MessageGroup has no automatic live-log or pagination behavior. Optional Bubble children and new-message announcements remain explicit caller composition.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
